prompt: The attached image is a 244x240 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Yellow duck</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:244px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
canvas{display:block;width:244px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xffffff);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true, antialias:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(244, 240, false);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-122,122,120,-120,1,1500);
ref.position.set(122,120,480);
ref.lookAt(122,120,0);

const duck = new THREE.Group();
duck.name = 'character-yellow-duck';
duck.position.set(124,120,0);
scene.add(duck);
const characters = [duck];

function group(parent,name,x=0,y=0,z=0) {
  const part = new THREE.Group();
  part.name = name;
  part.position.set(x,y,z);
  parent.add(part);
  return part;
}

function color(value) {
  return new THREE.Color(value);
}

function oval(parent,name,position,scale,tint,tilt=0,roughness=.84) {
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,28),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:tint,roughness})
  );
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.set(...position);
  mesh.scale.set(...scale);
  mesh.rotation.z = tilt;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const smooth = (a,b,x) => THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(x,a,b);

function shell(parent,name,sections,paint) {
  const centers = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
    sections.map(([x,y,z]) => new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z)),
    false,'catmullrom',.43
  );
  const radii = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
    sections.map(([, , ,w,d]) => new THREE.Vector3(w,d,0)),
    false,'catmullrom',.45
  );
  const vertices = [], shades = [], indices = [];
  const length = 104, sides = 112;
  for(let row=0;row<=length;row++) {
    const t=row/length;
    const p=centers.getPoint(t), r=radii.getPoint(t);
    const tangent=centers.getTangent(t);
    const across=new THREE.Vector2(-tangent.y,tangent.x).normalize();
    for(let side=0;side<=sides;side++) {
      const angle=2*Math.PI*side/sides;
      const u=Math.sin(angle), v=Math.cos(angle);
      const x=p.x+across.x*u*Math.max(.015,r.x);
      const y=p.y+across.y*u*Math.max(.015,r.x);
      const z=p.z+v*Math.max(.015,r.y);
      vertices.push(x,y,z);
      const tint=paint(x,y,z,u,v,t);
      shades.push(tint.r,tint.g,tint.b);
      if(row<length && side<sides) {
        const i=row*(sides+1)+side;
        indices.push(i,i+sides+1,i+1,i+1,i+sides+1,i+sides+2);
      }
    }
  }
  const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices,3));
  geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(shades,3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const normal=geometry.attributes.normal;
  for(let row=0;row<=length;row++) {
    const first=row*(sides+1), last=first+sides;
    const n=new THREE.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(normal,first)
      .add(new THREE.Vector3().fromBufferAttribute(normal,last)).normalize();
    normal.setXYZ(first,n.x,n.y,n.z);
    normal.setXYZ(last,n.x,n.y,n.z);
  }
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    vertexColors:true,roughness:.88
  }));
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const torso = group(duck,'body');
const gold=color(0xe4af36);
const crown=color(0xf1dd57);
const breast=color(0xffd5a8);
const lower=color(0xe7b961);

shell(torso,'continuous-feathered-silhouette',[
  [0,126,-5,0,0],
  [0,121,-5,19,19],
  [0,111,-4,30,27],
  [-1,96,-4,37,34],
  [1,73,-5,45,42],
  [3,50,-5,60,49],
  [4,26,-7,71,56],
  [3,-1,-8,77,63],
  [1,-35,-10,86,71],
  [1,-70,-10,91,75],
  [0,-97,-10,87,72],
  [0,-120,-10,78,63],
  [0,-139,-10,62,48],
  [0,-151,-10,33,26],
  [0,-156,-10,0,0]
],(x,y,z,u,v)=>{
  const tint=gold.clone().lerp(crown,smooth(51,113,y)*.96);
  const mask=smooth(.29,.89,v)*(1-smooth(19,43,y))*smooth(-134,-87,y);
  const warmth=smooth(-44,-113,y);
  const belly=breast.clone().lerp(lower,warmth*.84);
  tint.lerp(belly,mask*.96);
  tint.lerp(color(0xffc75d),smooth(.45,1,v)*smooth(32,58,y)*(1-smooth(66,87,y))*.19);
  return tint;
});

const head=group(duck,'head',0,88,22);
const leftEye=group(head,'eye-left',-21,6,2);
const rightEye=group(head,'eye-right',21,11,1);
oval(leftEye,'soft-eye-rim',[0,0,0],[7,8,4],0xc2a13f,-.16);
oval(rightEye,'soft-eye-rim',[0,0,0],[7.1,8,4],0xc9ac46,.14);
oval(leftEye,'dark-eye',[.1,.2,3.0],[4.55,5.45,3.0],0x211909,-.24,.51);
oval(rightEye,'dark-eye',[.05,.1,3],[4.7,5.55,3.0],0x231a0a,.22,.51);
oval(leftEye,'catchlight',[-.95,1.65,5.65],[.82,.91,.47],0x87774b,0,.45);
oval(rightEye,'catchlight',[-.9,1.8,5.65],[.84,.88,.47],0x8e7e54,0,.45);

const bill=group(head,'mouth-and-bill',1,-16,7);
const billTop=color(0xf2bd4d);
const billMiddle=color(0xe5a13a);
const billBottom=color(0xd59034);
shell(bill,'rounded-orange-bill',[
  [0,14,-2,0,0],
  [0,11,0,14,5],
  [-1,6,2,24,9],
  [-1,0,3,25,11],
  [-1,-7,2,20,9],
  [-1,-13,-1,12,5],
  [-1,-16,-3,0,0]
],(x,y,z,u,v)=>{
  const tint=billBottom.clone().lerp(billMiddle,smooth(-13,2,y));
  return tint.lerp(billTop,smooth(2,13,y)*.98);
});

const wingGold=color(0xe3a831);
const wingSun=color(0xf3c44d);
const wingShade=color(0xc58b25);

function wingPaint(x,y,z,u,v,t) {
  return wingGold.clone().lerp(wingSun,(1-smooth(.1,.77,t))*.72)
    .lerp(wingShade,smooth(.48,1,t)*.55);
}

const leftArm=group(duck,'arm-left',-60,6,15);
shell(leftArm,'raised-left-wing',[
  [7,30,14,0,0],
  [3,25,13,13,12],
  [-5,15,10,21,18],
  [-8,3,5,23,22],
  [-7,-10,0,19,22],
  [-2,-20,-2,12,16],
  [5,-25,-4,0,0]
],wingPaint);

const rightArm=group(duck,'arm-right',77,11,15);
shell(rightArm,'raised-right-wing',[
  [12,28,10,0,0],
  [11,22,10,12,13],
  [9,11,7,17,19],
  [10,-1,3,22,22],
  [8,-12,-1,21,20],
  [4,-20,-4,13,14],
  [-3,-22,-7,0,0]
],wingPaint);

const tipDark=color(0x4e3921);
const tipLight=color(0x79613b);
const tipEdge=color(0x94713c);
function tipPaint(x,y,z,u,v,t) {
  return tipDark.clone().lerp(tipLight,smooth(-.27,.9,v)*.57)
    .lerp(tipEdge,smooth(.64,.97,t)*.46);
}

const leftHand=group(leftArm,'hand-left',7,21,20);
shell(leftHand,'dark-left-wingtip',[
  [-5,19,-2,0,0],
  [-5,16,1,8,6],
  [-3,11,4,14,10],
  [0,5,5,17,12],
  [3,-2,3,15,12],
  [7,-10,0,12,8],
  [9,-13,-2,0,0]
],tipPaint);

const rightHand=group(rightArm,'hand-right',10,22,17);
shell(rightHand,'dark-right-wingtip',[
  [2,25,-4,0,0],
  [4,21,-2,5,5],
  [4,16,1,9,8],
  [3,9,4,13,10],
  [0,1,4,13,9],
  [-5,-7,1,9,6],
  [-6,-10,-2,0,0]
],tipPaint);

const backdrop=new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(700,580),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    vertexShader:`
      varying vec2 location;
      void main(){
        location=(modelMatrix*vec4(position,1.0)).xy;
        gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);
      }`,
    fragmentShader:`
      varying vec2 location;
      void main(){
        float haze=1.0-smoothstep(-7.0,38.0,location.y);
        float shade=exp(-pow((location.x-125.0)/96.0,2.0)
                        -pow((location.y+5.0)/24.0,2.0));
        vec3 background=mix(vec3(1.0),vec3(.70,.71,.73),haze*.92);
        background=mix(background,vec3(.47,.43,.37),shade*.24*haze);
        gl_FragColor=vec4(background,1.0);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>
      }`,
    depthWrite:false
  })
);
backdrop.name='white-studio-background';
backdrop.position.set(122,120,-230);
backdrop.renderOrder=-10;
scene.add(backdrop);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff7dc,0xb09a83,1.55));
const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff2ce,1.72);
key.position.set(-95,345,230);
scene.add(key);
const fill=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,.42);
fill.position.set(310,160,165);
scene.add(fill);
const rim=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffedc0,.9);
rim.position.set(110,220,-240);
scene.add(rim);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:true};
</script>
</body>
</html>
